title: Gloria Petkova by Richard Kern
author: Mart Kawaii
body_html:
the italic text is the original one and it was written last night.. I will leave it as an artefact. This text may also be bad. But remember, I’m putting all these words  just cause they look nice around Gloria’s body. DON’T PAY ATTENTION TO THEM. They’re just a decoration. I guess I didn’t even have to say that to you, I’ve already lost you couple of lines ago.

Richard Kern is traveling around the world stripping and filming girls. A totally “fuck yeah” job. On his last year’s trip to Eastern Europe he stopped by in Bulgaria and the result is this photo of Gloria Petkova.  Which made my night and many after.

This should be the March US edition. Or at least the cover says volume 19, number 3. Sounds like it… . See the whole session here.

I found the magazine, [now laying on my own wrinkled sheets.] right after sex. A girl, Hannah, had her 21st b-day. I didn’t had sex with her, though.

Then I went home and got drunk. [you didn’t forget this is all just decoration, so I can say everything, DON’T READ]

Here is a picture of me with the magazine. Like 8 pm yesterday. My chin is still ok. I kind of burned it after, but I guess I’ll be fine.

However, here is how my drunk blogging two hours after the picture looks like:

“I found her. Topless. With a phone between her tits. Never gave attention to the phone, though.

I hit on the magazine sitting and drinking beer in the TLIOF Headquaters. A girl, Hannah, had her 21st b-day. I felt proud being Bulgarian. Keep it rocking, darling! <3

You can Gloria how gorgeous she is in Facebook or check her blog. Also check all other hot girls in the session in Vice. Fuck motherfucking YES!”

I’m pretty sure you haven’t read this article,  or at least you shouldn’t, just as I never gave attention to this phone. I’m still curious if it’s her personal one. Gloria?
